WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-103.271398 43.990679)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
slope_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(s.rast, 1, o.pt) AS slope_degrees
FROM slope_rast s, origin o;

  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Reptile Gardens'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Rapid City'

)
SELECT
  degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(ST_Envelope(r.rast)), ST_Centroid(ST_Envelope(r.rast)))) AS aspect,

  (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, '32BF'), 1)).val AS slope_degrees
FROM
  public.dem_us r,
  poi_geom p
WHERE
  ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  AND ST_Distance(ST_Centroid(r.rast), p.geometry::geometry) < 100;
